subject: SI Enablement — Squad-based Orchestration & Shadow Program
messages:
From: Miguel Santos <miguel@fathom-consulting.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: [Fathom x Redwood] Partner enablement proposal & intake

Hi Rachel —

Thanks again for the intro last week. Fathom is excited to move from discovery to a tangible enablement plan focused on enabling our consulting squads to deliver Redwood-powered integrations to enterprise customers. I attached a short intake (fathom-redwood-intake.pdf) that outlines our current field structure, expected ramp targets, and the top three use cases we want to operationalize: observability-driven prompt tuning, private deployment for regulated clients, and cost-aware batching patterns.

High-level asks from our side:
- A two-week shadow program where 3 Fathom consultants ride with Redwood SI engineers during joint workshops.
- A living squad charter template we can apply across 4 squads.
- Co-branded assets for customer-facing workshops and an internal enablement checklist.

Target timeline (rough): intake sign-off by Mar 28, shadow week in mid-April, initial workshop pilot in May. Happy to be flexible — wanted to share this to align expectations.

Attachments: fathom-redwood-intake.pdf (summary, use cases, contacts)

—Miguel
Miguel Santos
Head of Integrations, Fathom Consulting
miguel@fathom-consulting.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: Miguel Santos <miguel@fathom-consulting.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [Fathom x Redwood] Partner enablement proposal & intake

Miguel —

Appreciate the clear intake. This is a great start. I attached a proposed "SI Squad Charter" (rbw-si-squad-charter.docx) that maps roles, outcomes, and a 6-week ramp plan. A few quick notes:

- Shadow program: we can host three seats/week for the April 9–20 window. We'll pair each Fathom consultant with a dedicated Redwood squad lead.
- Workshops: recommend a 2-day customer workshop (day 1: architecture & security, day 2: tuning & ops). We can co-deliver the pilot for one strategic customer in May.
- Metrics: early success should be measured by first-deployment time, post-workshop adoption (tracked in HubSpot), and a short-term NPS from customer attendees.

Next steps: can you confirm which Fathom consultants will participate (names + emails) and whether Fathom prefers hosted training (Redwood Hosted API) or a Private deployment exercise for the pilot? Once we have that, Ben and I will draft a mutual action plan and calendar invites.

Attachments: rbw-si-squad-charter.docx

Thanks — looking forward.

Rachel Kim
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>, Miguel Santos <miguel@fathom-consulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2028-03-23T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [Fathom x Redwood] Partner enablement proposal & intake

Adding a few operational points from our side:

- Integration checklist: I'll share an editable onboarding checklist (partner-onboarding-checklist.xlsx) the team can use to track credentials, test data, and performance targets.
- Dev tooling: recommend we provision a joint GitHub repo and a sample app that demonstrates Dedicated-to-Hosted fallbacks and token-level cost dashboards.
- Security: for the Private deployment pilot, our security team will send a brief questionnaire (SOC 2 artifacts + minimal network requirements). If the pilot is sensitive, we can run a short on-prem demo with a masked dataset.

I'll pencil in an internal pre-kick meeting on Apr 2 to align squad leads; Rachel, can you own attendee invites? Miguel, if you can share the consultant list before Mar 28 that will help us finalize which squad leads to assign.

Best,
Ben
Senior Partner Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Miguel Santos <miguel@fathom-consulting.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2028-03-23T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [Fathom x Redwood] Partner enablement proposal & intake

Ben, Rachel —

Thanks for the detail. Confirming the consultant slate: Lucia Park (lpark@fathom.com), Jorge Alvarez (jalvarez@fathom.com), and Priya Nair (pnair@fathom.com). They prefer a mix of hosted training first, followed by a Private deployment tabletop before the pilot.

Updated timeline: sign-off by Mar 28, pre-kick on Apr 2, shadow weeks Apr 9–13 (Lucia + Priya) and Apr 16–20 (Jorge). Pilot workshop target May 8–9. We have created a HubSpot opportunity and uploaded the intake (link below). Also open to DocuSign for a standard partner SOW if Redwood prefers — here's a placeholder link.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/links/abc-ff6d-2028

Attachments: none in this reply.

—Miguel
